D-001.threat: Fieldbus flooding causing denial of service at {{targetName}}
D-001.cause: {{targetName}} has no rate limiting on {{dataFlowName}} — all incoming frames are processed regardless of volume
D-001.attack: Attacker floods {{dataFlowName}} with high-frequency frames, saturating {{targetName}} communication stack

D-002.threat: Fieldbus flooding: Attacker saturates {{targetName}} input buffer via high-frequency frames from {{sourceName}}
D-002.cause: {{targetName}} has no rate limiting on its communication interface — all incoming frames are queued and processed
D-002.attack: Attacker floods the fieldbus with high-frequency frames exhausting {{targetName}} communication stack

D-003.threat: Cable disconnection causing loss of availability — no redundant path for field cable
D-003.cause: Data flow uses a single field cable with no redundant path
D-003.attack: Attacker cuts or disconnects the field cable, causing complete loss of the data flow

D-004.threat: Disruption of safety-critical data flow — safety function unavailable on demand
D-004.cause: Safety-critical data flow has no redundant path — disruption directly prevents the safety function from operating
D-004.attack: Attacker floods or physically disrupts the safety-critical data flow, preventing emergency stop commands from reaching their destination
